personal.name: Abdulkarim G. Mohammed
personal.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & AI/LLM Specialist
personal.tagline: I design and ship production-grade web platforms and LLM-powered features end to end — from system architecture to deployment.
personal.bio:
I'm Abdulkarim — a senior full-stack engineer based in Addis Ababa with 5+ years shipping software for clients around the world. I hold Top Rated status on Upwork (top 3% in Ethiopia) and I've built everything from fintech banking backends to AI-assisted call-management systems.

These days I work where web engineering meets applied AI: designing Next.js and NestJS platforms, wiring up LLM features with LangChain and LangGraph, and training and evaluating frontier models — RLHF, prompt engineering, side-by-side comparison — for teams like Turing. I care about clean architecture, measurable impact, and code that survives contact with real users.

I also published research on hate-speech detection for Afan Oromo, a low-resource language, reaching 90%+ accuracy — because I like hard problems that matter.
